image.prompt: Painterly illustration in a 70/30 style blend: primarily (70%) the atmospheric, painterly style of the animated series Scavengers Reign — muted naturalistic palette, organic textures, soft volumetric haze and lighting, subtle bioluminescent color accents — blended with (30%) the warm, soft style of Studio Ghibli background art. Gentle brushwork, soft diffused light, calm and cozy mood, no harsh shadows. No text, no logos, no watermark. Tuesday, a 3-year-old girl with a short chestnut-blonde bob haircut (a darker, warm honey-brown blonde) with a soft fringe, rosy cheeks and a small button nose. She looks clearly three, not a baby: a slightly slimmer face that has lost most of its baby chubbiness, longer legs and a taller, steadier standing posture, proportions of a preschooler rather than an infant. She wears a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down and stands beneath towering old-growth Douglas fir and western redcedar in a Pacific Northwest forest. Thick green moss covers the ground and trunks, soft mist drifts between the trees, rain falls softly through the canopy. Overcast, diffused gray-green light; a cool green and gray palette with the yellow raincoat as the single saturated warm color. Tuesday centered in the lower third, tall trees framing both sides, a canopy opening above. Horizontal 16:9 landscape composition.

video.prompt: Rain falls steadily and continuously through the canopy at a constant rate, visible as soft falling streaks. Occasional single drips fall from leaf tips at the edges of frame. Thin mist drifts slowly and uniformly between the trunks. Tuesday stands still with only the faintest sway of her raincoat. Locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. Slow, continuous, cyclical, steady-state motion only — nothing that builds, changes pose, or tells a story. Lighting and color held constant throughout. The final frame returns exactly to the starting image so the clip loops seamlessly. No text, no captions, no audio.
video.negative_prompt: camera movement, zoom, pan, cuts, scene change, lighting change, new characters, text, subtitles, morphing faces, extra limbs
video.audio_note: Veo 3.1 always generates audio; build_loop.py discards it
